description: Derived from AGSC-01-26: `export --okf` emits the lint-normalized Bundle itself, one `.md` file per published item with its bytes unchanged, the Bundle root document content/index.md carrying `bundle_version` beside `spec_version` and `okf_version`, the OKF-reserved content/log.md, and a LICENSE-CONTENT file at the export root. The minimal fixture is given a LICENSE-CONTENT and three concepts: edited (a date and a later modified date), undated (neither) and draft-note (status draft). Paths are relative to the export root. `files` is the whole list of files the export writes, so the draft is absent (AGSC-06-30). Every item file and LICENSE-CONTENT are the Bundle's own bytes (`byte_preserving`). content/log.md is one line `- <slug>: <modified, else date, else the empty string>` per published item in slug order, derived from the items alone. content/index.md contains the OKF version and the content version of AGSC-04-25, which for a Bundle with no git history built at SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH 1767225600 is 0.0.0 with the build instant as its build metadata. The export exits 0.
